app.name: Handover
login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email and password to access your account.
login.tagline: A website owner's manual generator for agencies
login.signupDescription: Start generating client manuals in minutes.
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
login.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
login.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
login.signupError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.checkEmail: Check your email — we've sent a confirmation link to:
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
reset.sent: If that address has an account, we've sent a reset link. Check your email.
reset.setNewPasswordDescription: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.updateError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
manuals.title: Manuals
manuals.subtitle: {agency} — your client manuals
manuals.limitDescription: You can create one manual on the free plan. Upgrade to create unlimited manuals.
manuals.emptyDescription: Create your first client manual. You'll fill in the details, and we'll generate a professional document your client can read and print.
manuals.linkCopiedDesc: The public URL is in your clipboard.
manuals.newDialog.title: New manual
manuals.newDialog.clientNameHelp: This becomes the manual's title. You can change it later.
manuals.draftWarn.title: This manual is a draft
manuals.draftWarn.body: This manual is only {percent}% complete. Sharing it now means your client will see a manual with missing information. Are you sure you want to open it?
settings.title: Agency Settings
settings.subtitle: This branding appears on every client manual you generate. Set it up once.
settings.identityDescription: Your agency's name and logo as they appear on manuals.
settings.logoUrlHelp: Paste a link to your logo image. It will appear at the top of every manual.
settings.agencyWebsiteHelp: Your logo links here on every manual you publish.
settings.logoUrlSchemeError: Logo URLs must start with https:// — an insecure image won't display on your client's manual.
settings.brandColorDescription: Used for headings and accents on the manual. Choose a color that matches your brand.
settings.previewBody: Headings and accents will use this color.
settings.supportDescription: How clients should reach you for day-to-day support and emergencies.
settings.emergencyPhoneHelp: For urgent issues only — shown on the emergency contacts section of each manual.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language for the Handover interface. This does not affect the language of individual manuals.
settings.billingDescription: Your plan determines how many manuals you can create and whether the Handover footer appears.
settings.paidPlan: Paid plan — unlimited manuals, no Handover footer
settings.freePlan: Free plan — one manual, with a small "Made with Handover" line on it.
settings.upgradePrice: $29/month or $290/year. Unlimited manuals, and your manuals carry only your branding.
settings.upgradeNote: Your account is upgraded once payment clears — usually within a few hours. Email hello@handover.agency if anything looks wrong.
settings.savedDesc: Your agency branding has been updated.
edit.subtitle: Fill in the factual details — we write the professional copy for you.
edit.completion.allFilled: All fields filled — ready to share.
edit.completion.missing: {count} field{count, plural, one {} other {s}} still missing
edit.draftWarn.title: This manual is a draft
edit.draftWarn.body: This manual is only {percent}% complete. Sharing it now means your client will see a manual with missing information. Are you sure you want to preview it?
edit.deleteSection.title: Delete section?
edit.deleteSection.body: Deleting this section will also delete all fields inside it. This cannot be undone.
edit.localeWarn.title: Change manual language?
edit.localeWarn.body: Fields that still contain the default text will be re-rendered in {locale}. Text you have already edited will not be changed.
public.manualNotFoundDesc: This manual may have been moved or deleted.
public.noAccounts: No accounts have been recorded yet.
secretName.blocked: Handover doesn't store passwords or keys — not even in custom fields. Record where the account lives and who owns it, and let the client hold the credential itself.
secretName.warned: If this field is for a credential, don't fill it in — record who owns the account instead.
edit.accountsMicrocopy: We never store passwords. This section records which accounts exist and who owns them. Your client keeps their own credentials — which means if Handover is ever breached, there is nothing here to steal.
edit.assetsEmpty: No files or assets recorded yet.
edit.assetUrlInvalid: Links must start with http:// or https://.
edit.assetUrlShareWarning: This looks like a share link — anyone who can open this manual can open this file. If that is not what you want, record where the file lives instead of linking to it.
settings.logoDrop: Click to upload or drop a file here
settings.logoRejection: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. SVG isn’t supported — export a PNG at 2x for a crisp logo.
settings.logoUrlHelp: Paste a direct link to your logo image (https:// only). Works well if your logo is already on a CDN.
settings.typefaceDescription: The fonts used for headings and body text on your client manuals.
settings.customFontNameError: Use letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores only (max 40 characters).
settings.customFontUrlStylesheetError: That looks like a Google Fonts stylesheet, not a font file. Choose a font from the list above, or paste a direct link to a .woff2, .woff, .otf or .ttf file.
settings.customFontUrlSchemeError: Font file URLs must start with https://.
settings.customFontUrlExtensionError: The URL must end in .woff2, .woff, .otf or .ttf.
settings.typefacePreviewBody: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
edit.sendToClientBody:
Hi,

Here is the link to your website owner's manual:
{url}

Let us know if you have any questions.
edit.contactsPrivacy: Only you can see this. These details are not shown on the manual.
maintenance.warned: This mentions a credential. Nothing here is stored as a secret, and this section is public — don't write anything you wouldn't hand to the client.
edit.maintenanceStandardHint: Twenty-one tasks a typical site needs, with a suggested owner on each. Edit, reassign or delete any of them.
